title: Applicability of regulations

blocks.html: The provisions of Section 81-60, inclusive, shall apply in the East Midtown Subdistrict as follows:
blocks.plainText: The provisions of Section 81-60, inclusive, shall apply in the East Midtown Subdistrict as follows:

blocks.html: (a)        Section 81-61, inclusive, sets forth general provisions, applicability and definitions for the East Midtown Subdistrict;
blocks.plainText: (a) Section 81-61, inclusive, sets forth general provisions, applicability and definitions for the East Midtown Subdistrict;

blocks.html: (b)        Section 81-62, inclusive, sets forth special use provisions;
blocks.plainText: (b) Section 81-62, inclusive, sets forth special use provisions;

blocks.html: (c)        Section 81-63, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for the Vanderbilt Corridor Subarea;
blocks.plainText: (c) Section 81-63, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for the Vanderbilt Corridor Subarea;

blocks.html: (d)        Section 81-64, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for qualifying sites;
blocks.plainText: (d) Section 81-64, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for qualifying sites;

blocks.html: (e)        Section 81-65, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for all other zoning lots;
blocks.plainText: (e) Section 81-65, inclusive, sets forth special floor area provisions for all other zoning lots;

blocks.html: (f)        Section 81-66, inclusive, sets forth certain height and setback modifications to the provisions of Sections 81-26 and 81-27;
blocks.plainText: (f) Section 81-66, inclusive, sets forth certain height and setback modifications to the provisions of Sections 81-26 and 81-27;

blocks.html: (g)        Section 81-67, inclusive, sets forth certain modifications to the mandatory district plan elements of Section 81-40, inclusive; and
blocks.plainText: (g) Section 81-67, inclusive, sets forth certain modifications to the mandatory district plan elements of Section 81-40, inclusive; and

blocks.html: (h)        Section 81-68, inclusive, sets forth additional provisions pertaining to qualifying sites.
blocks.plainText: (h) Section 81-68, inclusive, sets forth additional provisions pertaining to qualifying sites.
